name: Felix & Paul Studios 2024
summary:
Explore the vast and varied cinematic virtual reality worlds of EMMY award-winning Felix & Paul Studios.

Go from awe-inspiring romps through Jurassic World, feeling the presence and close proximity of a dinosaur, to a first-hand tour of The White House guided by President Barack Obama and First Lady Michelle Obama.
